method: 20 public search queries with only primary Mozilla Bugzilla/Microsoft Playwright/Vercel Next.js issue evidence relied upon; close analogies compared against retained actual log/harness. Unrelated returned sources were not used. No browser tests, code or browser-setting changes performed.

conclusions: Native content-process failure is observed; specific cause remains unknown.
Neither a bare SIG11 nor the subsequent disposed Juggler channel identifies the faulting subsystem.
Earlier windowGlobalChild/removeProgressListener warnings occur before processing completes; no demonstrated causal link to later native exit.
No OOM, general image decoder, Next16/React18, CSS dialog/backdrop, CPU or host-version cause is established.
Matched minimal reproducible trigger or native stack would be needed to associate this failure with a specific upstream issue.
No environment bypass or removal of sandbox/security settings is proposed.
